hero.desktopDescription: Classes start August 10, 2026, and end May 26, 2027. Thanksgiving holidays run November 23-27, and spring holidays run March 15-19. editorialSummary.heading: Winter Break, Storm Days and Early Release
paragraphs: Friday, December 18, 2026, is a full school day for all students, even though it is also the end of the first semester and a high school testing day. Christmas holidays are scheduled to begin December 21, but that Monday may be used as a Storm Day if needed. Teachers have a records workday January 4, and students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

Six dates on the 2026-2027 calendar may be used for storm make-up classes. Four are teacher PLC planning days: September 30 and October 28, 2026, and February 3 and April 14, 2027. The other two are Fall Break on October 9 and the first planned Christmas holiday on December 21. Students are scheduled to be off unless the district announces a change. Thanksgiving holidays are November 23-27, and spring holidays are March 15-19. Students return from spring break March 22, with Good Friday falling separately on March 26.

The final two school days have different dismissal rules. May 25, 2027, is an early-release day for high school students only. May 26 is the last day of school, with early release for all students. The district calendar does not list dismissal times, so families should check with their schools. Final report cards are scheduled to appear in the Parent Portal on June 9.

about.dataSource: This record follows the district’s 2026-2027 Student Academic Calendar, Board Approved October 28, 2025. The supplied local PDF matches the current official short-link download byte for byte. The district Academic Calendar page independently lists the school dates, report cards and graduations.
about.processing: Each possible Storm Day is its own conditional no-class event: four PLC dates, the Friday fall holiday and the opening winter holiday date. Only that first winter weekday is conditional; the rest of the holiday and the January records day are separate confirmed events. Holiday ends are derived from the published return dates. Thanksgiving Day stays as a named holiday covered by its enclosing break, so closure totals count it once. Consecutive December testing dates are grouped; full-day December and shortened last-day meanings each share one canonical occurrence. Final June report cards and school-specific graduation entries remain student milestones. Staff pre-planning and post-planning, plus Memorial Day outside the student year, are omitted. Both years have 208 weekdays in the attendance span: 26 confirmed closures plus six currently scheduled conditional closures leave 176 attendance dates. No exam-period or early-release clock times are supplied.
about.updates: Official calendar links, the downloadable 2026-2027 PDF and available district News and Live Feed pages were checked October 15, 2026. The web table omits the PDF’s Storm Day qualifier beside April 14; the explicit PDF designation remains in force in this record. Generic online all-day event endpoints are not used to extend holidays across a stated student return date.
about.disclaimer: Confirm any activated Storm Day with Bay District Schools. Individual schools supply exam reporting instructions, pickup times and graduation details; a school-specific ceremony does not make the date a holiday for everyone.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Bay County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Bay District Schools students start Monday, August 10, 2026. Staff planning and professional learning days take place before students return.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Bay District Schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, May 26, 2027, is the last day of school for all students. All students have early release that day. Teacher post-planning on May 27-28 does not extend the student school year.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Bay County schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students are off November 23-27, 2026, for the entire Thanksgiving week. Classes resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Christmas break for Bay District Schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The planned student break runs December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. Students return Tuesday, January 5. December 21 may be used as a Storm Day if needed, and January 4 is a teacher records workday.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Bay County, Florida, in 2027?
faqs.answer: Bay District Schools' spring holidays are March 15-19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22. Good Friday, March 26, is a separate day off, not part of the spring break week.

faqs.question: Is there school on October 9 or October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: The published calendar has no student classes scheduled for Friday, October 9, or Monday, October 12. October 9 is Fall Break and may be used as a Storm Day if needed. October 12 is the Columbus Day holiday. Classes are scheduled to resume October 13.

faqs.question: What are the possible Storm Days for Bay District Schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Six dates are marked as possible Storm Days: September 30, October 9, October 28 and December 21, 2026; February 3 and April 14, 2027. Students are scheduled to be off on these dates unless the district uses one or more for storm make-up classes. The calendar does not specify which date would be used first.

faqs.question: Do students attend school on teacher PLC planning days?
faqs.answer: Not under the published schedule. Students are off September 30 and October 28, 2026, and February 3 and April 14, 2027, while teachers have PLC planning days. All four dates are also designated as possible Storm Days, so families should check for district updates.

faqs.question: Is December 18, 2026, a half day for students?
faqs.answer: No. Bay District Schools explicitly lists December 18 as a full day for all students. It is also a high school testing day and the last day of the first semester.

faqs.question: When are high school testing days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists high school testing December 16-18, 2026, and May 24-26, 2027. Individual high schools provide exam times and reporting instructions.

faqs.question: When are the early release days in May 2027?
faqs.answer: May 25, 2027, is an early-release day for high school students only. On May 26, the last day of school, all students have early release. Elementary and middle school families should not use the May 25 high school schedule.

faqs.question: What time does school dismiss on the early release days?
faqs.answer: The district's annual academic calendar does not publish dismissal times for May 25 or May 26, 2027. Check your child's school for pickup, bus and exam-day instructions.

faqs.question: When are Bay District Schools report cards released in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled to be available in the Parent Portal on October 21, 2026, and January 13, March 31 and June 9, 2027. The June report card comes after the last student day on May 26.

faqs.question: Where can parents find progress reports?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are available through the district's Parent Portal. The annual calendar does not list specific progress-report release dates. Parents without internet access can contact their school for assistance.

faqs.question: When do the nine-week grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 8 and December 18, 2026, and March 12 and May 26, 2027. December 18 ends the first semester, and May 26 ends the second semester.

faqs.question: When are Bay District Schools graduation ceremonies in 2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists Bay Virtual on May 14, Rosenwald May 17, Arnold May 18, Bay May 19, MKL and Mosley May 20, Bozeman May 21, Rutherford May 24 and Haney May 25. Contact your school for ceremony times, locations, tickets and student instructions. These events do not indicate districtwide school closures.

faqs.question: When are school orientation and open house events?
faqs.answer: Orientation dates vary by school. The district lists selected September Mondays for high school open houses, Tuesdays for middle schools and Thursdays for elementary schools. Contact your school for its exact date and time.

faqs.question: Which school holidays are observed in Bay County in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The Bay District Schools calendar lists Labor Day on September 7, 2026, Columbus Day on October 12, Veterans Day on November 11, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, 2027, Presidents Day on February 15 and Good Friday on March 26. October 9 is a separate Fall Break date that may be used as a Storm Day. Thanksgiving, Christmas and spring holiday periods are listed separately.

faqs.question: How many student days are in the 2026-2027 school calendar?
faqs.answer: The official Bay District Schools calendar lists 176 student days. This is the published schedule before any possible Storm Day changes.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official Bay District Schools 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The district provides a Student Academic Calendar PDF marked Board Approved October 28, 2025. Use the official PDF download or Bay District Schools' Academic Calendar page to check for updates, including Storm Day announcements.

editorialSummary.heading: Spring Break, Storm Days and End-of-Year Dismissal
paragraphs: Spring break is scheduled for March 13-17, 2028, with students returning Monday, March 20. March 29 is a separate teacher PLC planning day. Students are scheduled to be off, but the date may be used for storm make-up classes if needed. Report cards are also scheduled to become available in the Parent Portal on March 29. Good Friday falls later, on April 14, and is not part of spring break.

Four teacher PLC planning days may also be used as Storm Days: September 29 and October 27, 2027, plus February 2 and March 29, 2028. Two other possible make-up dates are October 8, the first scheduled Fall Break day, and December 20, the planned start of winter break. December 17 is a full school day for all students, even though it marks the end of the first semester. January 3 is a teacher records workday, and students return January 4.

May 24, 2028, is an early-release day for high school students only. The school year ends May 25, with early release for all students. The annual calendar does not give specific dismissal times. Graduation dates vary by school, so families should confirm ceremony details directly with the school. Final report cards are scheduled for June 7.

about.dataSource: The supplied 2027-2028 Student Academic Calendar is marked Revised 9/8/2026. Bay’s live Academic Calendar page identifies the supplied Google Drive file ID as its 2027-2028 FINAL download. The local PDF was inspected in full; the stored content hash describes that local file, not a successfully downloaded Google response.
about.processing: Each possible Storm Day is its own conditional no-class event: four PLC dates, the Friday fall holiday and the opening winter holiday date. Only that first winter weekday is conditional; the rest of the holiday and the January records day are separate confirmed events. Holiday ends are derived from the published return dates. Thanksgiving Day stays as a named holiday covered by its enclosing break, so closure totals count it once. Consecutive December testing dates are grouped; full-day December and shortened last-day meanings each share one canonical occurrence. Final June report cards and school-specific graduation entries remain student milestones. Staff pre-planning and post-planning, plus Memorial Day outside the student year, are omitted. Both years have 208 weekdays in the attendance span: 26 confirmed closures plus six currently scheduled conditional closures leave 176 attendance dates. No exam-period or early-release clock times are supplied. The March and April monthly attendance subtotals conflict with the dated schedule; each shifts by one day but the annual sum agrees. The September 8, 2026 revision was rechecked against its stored SHA-256 and rendered page on October 19, 2026. Preserve its Fall Break label for October 11 and Winter Break wording rather than substituting the older Thrillshare PDF labels. The earlier PDF also differs for Bay Virtual, Rosenwald, Rutherford and MKL graduation dates and does not list North Bay Haven. Retain revised dates and ask families to confirm the current ceremony schedule.
about.updates: The district calendar page and its current 2027-2028 link were checked October 15, 2026. Google Drive downloads timed out, so this review cannot establish that the remote bytes match the supplied revision. September 8, 2026 is the printed revision date. The footer does not separately identify an original Board adoption date. On October 19, 2026, the live Academic Calendar page still linked the same Google Drive ID. The separately accessible Thrillshare PDF was downloaded and verified as the earlier Board Approved 10/28/2025 version; it does not supersede the supplied Revised 9/8/2026 copy.
about.disclaimer: Confirm any activated Storm Day with Bay District Schools. Individual schools supply exam reporting instructions, pickup times and graduation details; a school-specific ceremony does not make the date a holiday for everyone.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Bay County for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Bay District Schools students begin Tuesday, August 10, 2027. August 9 is a staff planning day, not a student attendance day.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Bay County in 2028?
faqs.answer: Thursday, May 25, 2028, is the last student day. All students have early release that day. Teacher post-planning takes place after the student year ends.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Bay District Schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: Students are off November 22-26, 2027, for Thanksgiving break. Classes resume Monday, November 29.

faqs.question: When is winter break for Bay District Schools in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Winter break is scheduled to begin December 20, 2027, with students returning January 4, 2028. December 20 may be used for storm make-up classes if needed. January 3 is a teacher records workday, with no student classes.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Bay County, Florida, in 2028?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 13-17, 2028. Bay District Schools students return Monday, March 20. Good Friday, April 14, is a separate holiday.

faqs.question: Is there school on October 8 or October 11, 2027?
faqs.answer: Under the September 8, 2026 revised calendar, students are off Friday, October 8, and Monday, October 11, for Fall Break. October 8 is a possible Storm Day; October 11 has no Storm Day designation. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, October 12, unless the district announces a change.

faqs.question: Which dates are possible Storm Days in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The six possible Storm Days are September 29, October 8, October 27 and December 20, 2027, plus February 2 and March 29, 2028. These are scheduled days off that may be used for make-up classes if needed. The calendar does not give an order for activating them.

faqs.question: Are teacher PLC planning days school days for students?
faqs.answer: No student classes are scheduled on September 29 and October 27, 2027, or February 2 and March 29, 2028. These are teacher PLC planning days, but all four may be used as Storm Days if the district announces a change.

faqs.question: Is December 17, 2027, a half day before winter break?
faqs.answer: No. December 17 is explicitly a full school day for all students. It is also a high school testing day and the final day of the first semester.

faqs.question: When are high school testing days in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: High school testing days are December 15-17, 2027, and May 23-25, 2028. The district calendar lists the dates but does not provide individual exam periods or testing times.

faqs.question: When are the early release days in May 2028?
faqs.answer: May 24, 2028, is an early-release day for high school students only. May 25 is the last day of school, with early release for all students.

faqs.question: What time is early release for Bay District Schools in May 2028?
faqs.answer: The annual district calendar does not list dismissal times for May 24 or May 25. Contact your child's school for pickup times, transportation arrangements and any high school exam-day instructions.

faqs.question: When are report cards available in the Parent Portal in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled for October 20, 2027, and January 12, March 29 and June 7, 2028. The dates are listed in the district's Student Academic Calendar.

faqs.question: Is there school on March 29, 2028, when report cards come out?
faqs.answer: Students are scheduled to be off March 29 for a teacher PLC planning day, although it may become a Storm Day if needed. Report cards are also scheduled to become available in the Parent Portal that day. The report-card release does not itself mean students must attend school.

faqs.question: Where can parents check student progress reports?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are available through the district's Parent Portal. The annual calendar does not specify progress-report release dates. Parents who do not have internet access can contact their school.

faqs.question: When do the grading periods and semesters end in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The nine-week grading periods end October 7 and December 17, 2027, and March 10 and May 25, 2028. The first semester ends December 17, and the second ends May 25.

faqs.question: When are Bay District Schools graduation ceremonies in 2028?
faqs.answer: The September 8, 2026 revised calendar lists Rosenwald on May 15, Rutherford on May 16, Bay Virtual and North Bay Haven on May 17, Arnold and MKL on May 18, Bay on May 19, Mosley on May 22, Bozeman on May 23 and Haney on May 24. Some dates differ from an earlier calendar version. Confirm your school's latest ceremony date, time and location before making plans.

faqs.question: When are school orientation and open house dates for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Orientation times and dates vary by school. The district calendar lists selected September Mondays for high school open houses, Tuesdays for middle schools and Thursdays for elementary schools. Each school provides its specific schedule.

faqs.question: Which school holidays are observed in Bay County in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists Labor Day on September 6, 2027, Veterans Day on November 11, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 17, 2028, Presidents Day on February 21 and Good Friday on April 14. Students also have Fall Break, Thanksgiving break, winter break and spring break.

faqs.question: How many student days are in the Bay District Schools 2027-2028 calendar?
faqs.answer: The revised 2027-2028 Student Academic Calendar lists 176 student days. That is the published schedule, with six designated dates available for storm make-up classes if needed.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official Bay District Schools 2027-2028 calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: Visit Bay District Schools' Academic Calendar page and select the 2027-2028 Student Academic Calendar PDF. This page follows the copy marked Revised September 8, 2026. Check the district's latest posted version for changes to graduation dates and Storm Day arrangements.
